data.name: SKYHIGH
data.detailed_description:
SkyHigh is an open-world crime experience where you play as Isaac, a prisoner who has just escaped after spending ten years behind bars.

Released into a world that has moved on without him, Isaac must start over from nothing. With no money, no support, and no easy way forward, survival becomes his first priority. After ten years behind bars, Isaac breaks free and disappears into a quiet town, believing freedom is the beginning of a new life. Instead, he finds himself drawn into a world of opportunity, danger, and crime.

Explore the town freely, take on missions, earn money, purchase items from shops, and decide how Isaac will survive in a place where every choice matters. Drive through the streets, complete objectives, and face the consequences of your actions as the police respond to criminal activity.

Progress through Isaac's journey as he works to build a future for himself while dealing with the challenges that come with freedom after a decade behind bars.

Gameplay Features

Open World Exploration

Travel freely across the town and discover different locations, businesses, and opportunities as you explore the world around you.

Story-Driven Missions

Take part in missions that follow Isaac's journey after escaping prison and trying to rebuild his life.

Vehicle Driving

Drive vehicles throughout the town to reach destinations, complete objectives, and explore the world.

Shooting and Combat

Use weapons during combat encounters and dangerous situations as you fight to survive.

Interactive Shops

Visit shops to purchase useful items and prepare for the challenges ahead.

In-Game Phone System

Use Isaac's phone to receive information, stay connected, and manage different activities throughout the game.

Police Response System

Criminal actions can attract police attention, creating tense situations and additional challenges as you navigate the town.

After ten years behind bars, freedom comes at a price.

How far will Isaac go to take his life back?

data.short_description: After ten years behind bars, Isaac breaks free and disappears into a quiet town. But freedom isn't what he imagined. With nothing to his name and the law on his trail, he must earn money, build connections, and survive as he struggles to rebuild his life from nothing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Game runs in HDRP, optimized for mid-range PCs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • Additional Notes: Game runs in HDRP, optimized for mid-range PCs.

content_descriptors.notes: Mature Content: This game contains realistic violence (shooting, killing, blood), criminal activities (theft, murder, drug dealing), non-explicit sexual content (strip clubs, prostitution, suggestive dancing), alcohol and tobacco use, prescription drug abuse, strong profanity, and simulated gambling. No explicit sex acts, sexual assault, self-harm, or suicide are depicted. For adult players only.
